# Most races at the World Rally Championship (individual)
![Most races at the World Rally Championship \(individual\)](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/images/css/gwr-ph.jpg)

[ Contact an Account Manager ](https://journey.guinnessworldrecords.com/contact/s/?language=en_GB) Who
    Sébastien Ogier What
     214 total number  Where
     Italy  When
     01 October 2026 
The most races at the World Rally Championship (individual) is 214, achieved by Sébastien Ogier (France) between 2008 and 2026.
Sébastien Ogier overtook Jari-Matti Latvala’s record of 213 WRC starts at the 2026 Rally Italia Sardegna. Ogier is a nine-time world rally champion, a joint-record with his compatriot Sébastien Loeb.
